【原视频简介】
I spent 4 MONTHS building the ULTIMATE Super Smelter in Minecraft… and it turned into something WAY bigger than I ever planned.

What started as a simple super smelter quickly turned into a massive underground project. I mined out an insane amount of blocks, built a huge underground facility, and created a smelting system capable of processing 70,000+ items per hour.

This project took months of planning, mining, building, and way too many hours in Minecraft — but the final result was worth it.

🔥 70,000+ items/hour
⛏️ Thousands of blocks mined
🏗️ Massive underground facility
📦 The ULTIMATE Minecraft Super Smelter

Thanks for watching! If you enjoyed the video, consider subscribing for more Hardcore Minecraft projects.
